## Overview

What this note covers.

## Definitions and Theorems

::: {#def-expectation}
## Expectation
For a random variable $X$ with density $f(x)$, the expectation is defined as

$$
E[X] = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x f(x)\, dx
$$ {#eq-expectation}
:::

::: {#thm-linearity}
## Linearity of Expectation
For any constants $a, b$, $E[aX + b] = aE[X] + b$.
:::

::: {.proof}
Follows from @eq-expectation and the linearity of the integral.
:::

@thm-linearity follows directly from @def-expectation.^[Footnotes appear in the right margin.]

## Examples

::: {#exm-normal}
If $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$, then $E[X] = \mu$.
:::
